visualStyle.lighting: flat overcast English light, dim interiors

analysis.themes: A disgraced puppeteer returns to his childhood home dragging a monstrous spider puppet — the film is trauma externalized, guilt crawling on eight legs.
analysis.atmosphere: Utterly bleak and airless; the Norfolk marshland and rotting interiors create dread without a single conventional scare beat.
analysis.narrative: Almost nothing is explained — the story is pieced together from fragments as the puppet, and what it stands for, becomes impossible to escape.
analysis.visual: Drained color, static suffocating frames, and the genuinely disturbing puppet design make the imagery feel like recovered memory.
analysis.characters: Philip is hollowed out by something the film withholds; his uncle Maurice is menace made mundane. Nearly a two-man chamber piece.
